svg.text: 🔒 CloudPulse DevSecOps • Automated CI/CD & Security Pipeline

g.text: 🛡️ Step 1: Pre-Commit Code Quality & SAST Secret Gate
Fast parallel quality gates: Ruff validates PEP 8 and imports, while Gitleaks audits complete Git commit history.
Rules: E, F, W, I • Line Length: 88
Full History Depth: Entire Git Tree
Zero tokens, API keys, or private certs
🧪 Step 2: Automated Chaos Simulation & Pytest Suite
FastAPI test client verifies dashboard HTML, Kubernetes /healthz probes, Prometheus telemetry, and outage failover.
Platform: Python 3.12 (Linux x86_64) • Root: pyproject.toml • autouse state isolation
Prometheus Metrics Scraped: GET /metrics 200 OK • SERVICE_HEALTH_STATUS: 1.0 (UP) • Latency Histogram Active
Builder stage isolates dependencies and purges SBOM files; Runtime stage drops privileges to UID 10001 (appuser).
🚀 Step 4: Trivy Container Gate & GHCR Registry Publish
Trivy enforces exit-code 1 gate. Remediated 3 HIGH CVEs ➔ Smoke tests pass ➔ Published to GHCR for GitOps Part 2.
Result: 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH • Image verified compliant
🚀 Ready for Argo CD GitOps Sync (Part 2)
CloudPulse DevSecOps Platform • Automated Security Factory (Part 1 of 2)
